{{Hatnote|Not to be confused with [[Arts Infliction]] which applies [[Arts Burst]] under certain conditions.}}
[[Arts Burst]] is a [[Combat Mechanic]] in [[Arknights: Endfield]].

== Overview ==
[[Arts Burst]] is an instance of {{G|DMG Type|Arts DMG}} applied by Operators.
* When an [[Operator]] applies an [[Arts Infliction]] to an enemy already affected by an Arts Infliction of the same element, the stacks of the Arts Infliction increases by 1 stack (up to 4 stacks) and an [[Arts Burst]] is triggered.
** Deals an instance of {{Color|160% ATK|1d}} as {{Tip|Base|Before being increased or decreased by other effects (Unofficial term)}} Arts DMG based on the element of the Arts Infliction.
** Can be divided into {{G|Heat Burst}}, {{G|Electric Burst}}, {{G|Cryo Burst}}, and {{G|Nature Burst}}.

== Calculations ==
<tabber>
|-|Arts DMG=
{{Hatnote|{{Main|Damage calculation}}}}
* The following effects stack <u>multiplicatively</u> with each other and with the Base {{Color|Arts DMG|7}}:
** Each operator level increases the Base Arts DMG by {{Tip|{{Color|~0.51%|1d}}|0.510204081%}}.
*** <math>{Level\,Multiplier} = \dfrac{195 + Operator\,Level}{196}</math><br>
** Each point of [[Arts Intensity]] increases the Base Arts DMG by {{Color|1%|1d}}.
*** <math>{Arts\,Intensity\,Multiplier} = \dfrac{100 + Arts\,Intensity}{100}</math><br>
** If the damage critically strikes, increases the Base Arts DMG by some amount equal to the [[Critical DMG]].
*** <math>
{Critical\,Multiplier} =
\begin{cases} 
1 + {Critical\,DMG},  & \mbox{if the hit is critical}\\
1, & \mbox{if the hit is not critical} 
\end{cases}
</math>
** If the enemy is {{Color|Staggered|8}}, increases the Base Arts DMG by {{Color|30%|1d}}.
* The following effects stack <u>additively</u> with each other but <u>multiplicatively</u> with the Base Arts DMG to form the <b>Multiplier Group</b>:
** <math>{Multiplier\,Group} = 1 + \sum {Damage\,Bonuses}</math><br>
** Arts DMG Bonus
** Heat DMG Bonus, Electric DMG Bonus, Cryo DMG Bonus, or Nature DMG Bonus (based on the [[Element]] of the Arts Burst)
** If the enemy is {{Color|Staggered|8}}, DMG Bonus vs. Staggered
* The following effects stack <u>additively</u> with each other but <u>multiplicatively</u> with the Base Arts DMG to form the <b>Amp Multiplier</b>:
** <math>{Amp\,Multiplier} = 1 + \sum {Damage\,Bonuses}</math><br>
** {{G|Arts Amp}}
** {{G|Heat Amp}}, {{G|Electric Amp}}, {{G|Cryo Amp}}, {{G|Nature Amp}} (based on the [[Element]] of the Arts Burst)
* The following effects stack <u>additively</u> with each other but <u>multiplicatively</u> with the Base {{Color|Arts DMG|7}} to form the <b>Susceptibility Multiplier</b>:
** <math>{Susceptibility\,Multiplier} = 1 + \sum {Damage\,Bonuses}</math><br>
** {{G|Arts Susceptibility}}
** {{G|Heat Susceptibility}} or {{G|Electric Susceptibility}} or {{G|Cryo Susceptibility}} or {{G|Nature Susceptibility}} (based on the [[Element]] of the Arts Burst)
* The following effects stack <u>additively</u> with each other but <u>multiplicatively</u> with the Base Arts DMG to form the <b>Increased DMG Taken Multiplier</b>:
** <math>{Increased\,DMG\,Taken\,Multiplier} = 1 + \sum {Damage\,Bonuses}</math><br>
** If the enemy is affected by Arts DMG Taken effects
** If the enemy is affected by Heat DMG Taken, Electric DMG Taken, Cryo DMG Taken, or Nature DMG Taken effects (based on the [[Element]] of the Arts Burst)
* If the enemy is affected by {{G|Electrification}}, increases the sum multiplier by {{Color|12 – 24% (based on the {{G|Status Level}})|1d}} at Base Strength
* The following effects stack <u>additively</u> with each other but <u>multiplicatively</u> with the Base {{Color|Arts DMG|7}} to form the <b>Resistance Multiplier</b>:
** <math>{Resistance\,Multiplier} = 1 + \sum {Damage\,Bonuses}</math><br>
** The enemy's Innate Heat Resistance, Electric Resistance, Cryo Resistance, or Nature Resistance (based on the [[Element]] of the Arts Burst) decreases the sum multiplier
** Ignore Heat Resistance ([[Laevatain]]) or Ignore Electric Resistance ([[Zhuang Fangyi]]) (if {{G|Heat Burst}} or {{G|Electric Burst}})
** If the enemy is affected by {{G|Corrosion}}, increases the sum multiplier by {{Color|3.6% – 24% (based on the {{G|Status Level}} and Total Duration Elapsed)|1d}}
</tabber>

==Changelog==
{{Changelog|
* <b>Beta Test II</b> {{Needs Verification}}
** {{G|Arts Burst}} changed.
*** <b>New:</b> When an Operator applies an {{G|Arts Infliction}} to an enemy who already has an Arts Infliction of the same element, add one more stack of Arts Infliction to the enemy (max 4 times) and trigger an Arts Burst.
*** <b>Old:</b> When an Operator applies an {{G|Arts Infliction}} to an enemy who already has an Arts Infliction of the same element, {{G|Debuff Consumption|consume}} all Arts Infliction stacks and trigger an Arts Burst.
* <b>Beta Test I</b> {{Needs Verification}}
** {{G|Arts Burst}} added.
*** {{G|Heat Burst}}, {{G|Electric Burst}}, {{G|Cryo Burst}}, and {{G|Nature Burst}} added.
*** When an Operator applies an {{G|Arts Infliction}} to an enemy who already has an Arts Infliction of the same element, {{G|Debuff Consumption|consume}} all Arts Infliction stacks and trigger an Arts Burst.
}}
